rule.en: Swipe to cut the lemon and drain the pieces without flies into the glass.
rule.sw: Pangusa kukata ndimu na umimine vipande visivyo na nzi kwenye glasi.

en: Swipe all the way across the lemon to cut it.
The piece without flies drops and drains into the glass. Fill it to 100%.
Cut through a fly and it's over. Each lemon brings more flies and fewer cuts.
sw: Kipande kisicho na nzi kinadondoka na kumiminika kwenye glasi. Ijaze hadi 100%.
Ukikata nzi, mchezo umekwisha. Kila ndimu ina nzi zaidi na mikato michache.

desc.en: When you send a challenge, you place the flies first. Your layout becomes your friend's board.
desc.sw: Unapotuma changamoto, unapanga nzi kwanza. Mpangilio wako unakuwa ubao wa rafiki yako.

source.en: Kiothi, where a player may redistribute one pit's seeds anywhere on the board before play
source.sw: Kiothi, ambapo mchezaji anaweza kugawa upya mbegu za shimo moja popote kabla ya mchezo

en.kd_line: I juiced {n} lemons before the flies got me
en.kd_place_body: Tap the lemon to place up to 5 flies. Your friend's first lemons start with your layout.

sw.kd_place_body: Gusa ndimu kupanga hadi nzi 5. Ndimu za kwanza za rafiki yako zinaanza na mpangilio wako.
